subject: Integrate an explicitly invoked clarification protocol into the fifteen-agent fleet

branches.title: Authority boundary
branches.question: Should Grill Me be a new autonomous agent or a shared protocol used by the current task owner?
branches.recommendation: Use a shared protocol, not a sixteenth agent.
branches.rationale: That preserves the singular Marketing Chief and verifier authorities.

branches.title: Runtime seam
branches.question: Where should the resumable interview receipt attach to an execution?
branches.recommendation: Attach a hashed clarification receipt to Agent Runtime Contract v1.
branches.rationale: The existing runtime already owns resumability, evidence, and approval state.

branches.title: Invocation policy
branches.question: Should every task be grilled automatically?
branches.rationale: Automatic interrogation would slow clear work and diverge from the source skill.
